findings.quote: people who believe that they can decide the fate of the planet, whether that be as regards the climate or AI.
findings.rationale: Criticizes concentrated power over decisions about AI.

findings.quote: Last but not least, we must hold fast and not yield on artificial intelligence.
findings.rationale: Introduces the commitment to an AI policy agenda elaborated in subsequent passages.

findings.quote: we advocated for two very simple things for everyone in the world to have their own LLM model capabilities, calculation capabilities, AI capabilities, so that we can craft a way of auditing these models instead of being reliant on just a few private actors.
findings.rationale: Discusses AI governance institutions, regulation, independent model capacity and auditing.

findings.quote: Rather, we must come together to build an open source frontier model, a cutting edge model using all of the calculation capabilities you have pooling them, our investment capabilities must be pooled to build a cutting edge open source AI model, which we will share.
findings.rationale: Proposes shared open source AI development and discusses child protection and security governance.

findings.quote: We want to set a cooperation agenda on AI so as to protect the most sensitive components thereof, which affect our national security.
findings.rationale: Calls for international AI cooperation concerning national security and sensitive applications.
